title: Median of Two Sorted Arrays
summary: Partition two sorted arrays without fully merging them.
statement: Return the median of two ascending arrays. At least one array is non-empty. The required running time is logarithmic in the shorter array.
constraints: At least one input is non-empty.
hints: A correct partition puts half the combined values on the left.
Binary-search how many values to take from the shorter array.
A partition is valid when both left-side maxima are <= both right-side minima.
Use infinities at empty partition edges, then derive the odd or even median.
editorial: Binary-search a partition in the shorter array and infer the complementary partition in the other. Adjust until cross-boundary ordering is valid.

tests.explanation: The merged order is [1, 2, 3], whose middle value is 2.
An even total length uses the average of the two middle values, 2 and 3.
